'''Marcus Wood This Deal Just Gets Worse''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Marcus Wood]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds112.htm This Deal Just Gets Worse], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020727095624/http://trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds112.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
